title: A little room to breathe
description: A quiet moment, wherever you are.

steps.title: Arrive as you are
steps.text: Set aside whatever can wait for a little while. You do not need to accomplish anything in this moment.

steps.title: Make a little space
steps.text: Relax your shoulders. Let your breathing settle naturally. Notice something ordinary around you.

steps.title: A quiet prayer
steps.text: Lord, help me receive this moment with gratitude, and carry a little peace into what comes next.
